description: What the merchant's source feed ACTUALLY contained, and what SKULayer did with each field: every field as their platform sends it, how many items carry a value for it, whether it was recognised as a shopping attribute, kept as a custom attribute, or arrived empty on every row, plus per-attribute coverage before and after the rule stack. Completes the triad with get_audit_findings (what SKULayer thinks) and get_merchant_issues (what Google thinks): this is what the merchant sent. Use it BEFORE proposing rules. It is the only way to tell an attribute the merchant never sends from one they send blank from one they send with a value we cannot use, all three of which look identical in the audit.
name: get_field_inventory
title: Get field inventory
